name: roundcube-skin-aurora
description: Build tooling for the Aurora skin. Roundcube users do not need this: the compiled files are part of the release.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: lessc --clean-css="--s1 --advanced" styles/styles.less styles/styles.min.css && lessc --clean-css="--s1 --advanced" styles/print.less styles/print.min.css && lessc --clean-css="--s1 --advanced" styles/embed.less styles/embed.min.css
